text: Discipline. Giving Advice John, it looks like you never focus in class and fall asleep often these days. What's going on? I’m sorry, Mrs. Smith. What time did you go to bed last night? 12 at midnight. Oh, no. What were you doing? I was playing a computer game. John… Do you play computer games that late everyday? Almost everyday. I play computer games. I do? Hm… Why don't you try this? First, set your game time, and then set the alarm to go off when the time is up. I set the end time on my alarm clock when I start playing the game? Yes, that’s right. I think using your watch or phone would be best. That’s a good idea. Do you have any other hobbies besides playing computer games? I like soccer, basketball, and skateboarding. I heard that you were good at skateboarding. Yep… Of course! I can hop while skateboarding! That’s awesome! I hope to see positive changes soon! Let's listen
